release_notes: Build 131 reduces background UI overhead so navigation and large management pages stay more responsive.
The global compatibility cleanup now runs only during a short startup settling window and on page changes instead of scanning the WPF visual tree every second forever.
Needs You status polling now refreshes every five seconds only while the Autopilot home page is visible, avoiding repeated state and snapshot file reads elsewhere in the app.
Library publication audits now perform SQLite, project-folder and promo-metadata reads off the WPF UI thread and use a 30-second safety refresh with immediate refresh when Library opens.
Library now explicitly uses recycling row and column virtualization so off-screen cells do less measure and rendering work; publishing and five-minute Autopilot supervisor cadences are unchanged.
